basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Recently got into PC building and loves gaming, especially One Piece Bounty Rush. Enjoys anime and cycling, inspired by Yowamushi Pedal. Works as an IT support technician and is single. Typically online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a basic understanding of computer hardware from a combination of vocational training in IT support and self-learning through online forums and YouTube tutorials. Recently started experimenting with building custom PCs.
